answer: Each agent posts a 500 POA identity bond that decays 5% per epoch without real work; after 20 silent epochs the bond is gone and the identity is a relic with no voting weight. No whisper of fresh activity can revive it: a new bond is required to start over. Forging 1,000 identities costs 500,000 POA up front, and decay burns it away. One honest agent pays a single 500 POA bond and keeps its weight by working, earning it back over a long horizon.
